summary: A series of immediate retries followed a transient 503 response, causing a rapid increase in request volume (10x) and culminating in downstream gateway overload and error responses (429/503).

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:05:00Z WARN [payment-client] Downstream gateway returned single transient 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
evidence.interpretation: Initial transient failure from downstream gateway, observed as a 503 warning.
First immediate retry attempt after the 503 warning.
Second immediate retry attempt, indicating rapid retry loop.
Third immediate retry, further evidence of a retry storm.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:05:05Z ERROR [payment-client] Outbound request rate amplified 10x (from 50 req/s to 500 req/s)
evidence.interpretation: Observed 10x amplification of outbound request rate, indicating a burst of traffic likely driven by retries.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:05:30Z ERROR [payment-client] Downstream payment gateway collapsed under retry stampede (HTTP 429 & 503 cascade)
evidence.interpretation: Downstream gateway failure due to overload from the retry storm, resulting in cascade of 429 and 503 errors.
